title: Brief amici curiae of Advancing American Freedom, et al

pages.text:
AFFIDAVIT OF SERVICE
SUPREME COURT OF THE UNITED STATES
No. 25A810
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------X
ELIZABETH MIRABELLI, LORI ANN WEST, JANE ROE, JANE BOE, JOHN POE, JANE
POE, JOHN DOE, AND JANE DOE,
Applicants,
v.
ROB BONTA, ATTORNEY GENERAL OF CALIFORNIA, ET AL.,
Respondents,
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------X
STATE OF NEW YORK )
COUNTY OF NEW YORK )
I, Ann Tosel, being duly sworn according to law and being over the age
of 18, upon my oath depose and say that:
I am retained by Counsel of Record for Amici Curiae.
That on the 21st day of January, 2026, I served the within Brief of Amici
Curiae Advancing American Freedom, et al. In Support of Applicants in the
above-captioned matter upon:
Paul Michael Jonna [U.S.P.S. Priority Mail]
Counsel of Record
LiMandri & Jonna LLP
16236 San Dieguito Road, Suite 3-15,
PO Box 9120
Rancho Santa Fe, CA 92067
pjonna@limandri.com
Ph: 8587599930

A
(800) 274-3321 • (800) 359-6859
www.counselpress.com
Julie Veroff
Deputy Solicitor General
Joshua A. Klein
Darrell W. Spence
Supervising Deputy Attorneys General
Jennifer A. Bunshoft
Kevin L. Quade
Deputy Attorneys General
State of California Department of Justice
455 Golden Gate Avenue, Suite 11000
San Francisco, CA 94102-7004
Telephone: (415) 510-3776
Julie.Veroff@doj.ca.gov
Joshua.Klein@doj.ca.gov
Darrell.Spence@doj.ca.gov
Jennifer.Bunshoft@doj.ca.gov
Kevin.Quade@doj.ca.gov
by sending one copy of same, addressed to each individual respectively,
through FedEx Priority.  An electronic version was also served by email to each
individual.
That on the same date as above, I sent to this Court three copies of the
within Brief of Amici Curiae Advancing American Freedom, et al. In Support
of Applicants through the Overnight Next Day Federal Express, postage
prepaid. In addition, the brief has been submitted through the Court’s
electronic filing system.
All parties required to be served have been served.
I declare under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and
correct.
Executed on this 21st day of January, 2026.
____________________________________
Ann Tosel

this 21st day of January, 2026.
